lines: There was a king to whom Allah had given a kingdom.
And because Allah had given him a kingdom, he argued with Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, about his Lord.
Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: my Lord is the One who gives life and causes death.
The king said: I give life and cause death.
So Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: "Indeed, Allah brings up the sun from the east, so bring it up from the west."
And the disbeliever was overwhelmed. A king, with all his kingdom... silenced by one sentence. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
